a.speaker: Arlo Dunmore
a.text: "Saw you hauling those blue jugs in on Saturday. Six of them. You planning a camping trip, or is there something on the news I missed?" He's smiling. He also keeps looking at your garage.

options.text: "Camping. The kids want to try the coast before it gets cold."
"Honestly? The fires last year. I'd rather have water and not need it."
"Come by Saturday and I'll show you the filter setup. Costs less than you'd think."
effects: Show Arlo the water filter setup

lie.speaker: Arlo Dunmore
lie.text: "The coast. Huh. Bring me back some taffy." He lets it go. Your Profile stays where it was; your street knows a little less about you.

truth.speaker: Arlo Dunmore
truth.text:
"Smart. I've got a generator in the garage I've never run. Maybe you can tell me which end the gas goes in." He means it as a joke. It isn't, quite.

Telling a household the plan gives Trust +1 and Profile +3.

invite.speaker: Arlo Dunmore
invite.text: "Deal." A promise is a Tally now: dated, witnessed, and remembered. Keep it and your Word grows; break it and the street hears.
